data.one_liner: Embed native Windows windows and components directly into a Flutter window.
data.what_it_does: Allows embedding arbitrary Win32 HWND windows into a Flutter application as a standard Widget. It uses Win32 APIs without intermediate pixel buffer copying to keep performance high.
use_when: You need to embed existing third-party native Windows windows into a Flutter desktop app.
You are building Windows desktop applications with Flutter and need performant native window embedding.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Windows, such as mobile or web.
You require fully stable interactive support with the embedded native views out of the box.
strengths: Very performant as it avoids texture or intermediate pixel buffer copying.
Supports placing other Flutter widgets on top of the native view.
Supports multiple instances of NativeView and placement inside scrollables.
weaknesses: Requires manual native C++ setup in `windows/runner/main.cpp`.
data.setup_notes: Requires modifying windows/runner/main.cpp to include the plugin header and initialize NativeViewContainer.
